Game Mode comment: Capitals matches tribes_rl.train defaults; also Might / Perfection / Domination / Glory
Map Type comment: Drylands / Lakes / Continents / Pangea / Archipelago / Water World
Map Size comment: Tiny / Small / Normal / Large / Huge / Massive
Seed comment: -1 picks a random seed each launch
Max Turns Capitals comment: Capitals/Might turn cap; code default is 50
Max Actions Per Turn comment: 0 disables this per-player turn action cap; code default is 80
Max Actions Per Game comment: 0 disables this total match action cap; code default is 512
Frame Delay comment: Milliseconds between GUI action updates; 1000 = watch at about 1 second per applied action
